title: LeakageSafe-ClinicalML
description: Reproducible research software for leakage-safe structured clinical machine learning, including repeated-holdout evaluation, training-strategy comparison, statistical analysis, subgroup fairness assessment, and traceable experimental results.
notes: This repository provides the reproducibility materials associated with a leakage-safe structured clinical machine-learning study. The archived release contains research software, experimental configurations, machine-readable results, and supporting documentation. Participant-level clinical data should be included only where redistribution is explicitly permitted.
